exports: assets/seed-tasks.json: JSON array of task objects with id, title, description, status, priority, createdAt, and updatedAt fields
assets/local-assets.json: asset manifest describing the seed data, localStorage key, UI guidance, and minimum local test checks
localStorage key for downstream JavaScript: localTaskBoard.tasks.v1
allowed task statuses: todo, doing, done
allowed task priorities: low, medium, high

manual_checks: Confirm assets/seed-tasks.json parses as valid JSON.
Confirm seed tasks include at least one task in each board status: todo, doing, and done.
Confirm assets/local-assets.json points to assets/seed-tasks.json and documents the localStorage key used by the app.
Confirm no media-processing assets, video pipeline assets, or external network dependencies are introduced.

checks: Generated only component-owned asset files under assets/.
Seed data contains four realistic task board records.
Seed data supports add/edit/delete workflows by defining mutable task fields and valid board statuses.
Asset manifest provides downstream integration contracts for index.html, style.css, script.js, localStorage, and npm test checks.

reasons: No README or documentation-only delivery files were generated by this component.
No duplicate paths exist in the provided prior manifest.
Files are local, relative, text-based, and require no external services.
The assets align with the raw user goal for a browser task board app and avoid the unrelated media workbench direction.
